title: D-024 Amendment 13 unit Q: DISABLE_AUTOUPDATER=1 control for controller-launched Claude workers + standing admission-event discipline
objective: Establish AND verify the supported DISABLE_AUTOUPDATER=1 control (Amendment 13 R278) BEFORE any fixture recapture (R279): (1) controller-launched Claude child processes receive DISABLE_AUTOUPDATER=1 durably - forced injection at the supervisor's claude child-environment seam (minimal_env S13/S13.3 call sites in claude_runner), NOT dependent on parent-environment inheritance or the env allowlist; (2) removal-sensitive tests proving the injection on every claude launch path and proving no OTHER environment change is introduced; (3) the workstation-scope control for the certification window is an OWNER-SIDE Windows action: deliver the exact administrator PowerShell command plus a verification command and STOP - never apply it from this side (R288); (4) document the standing admission-event discipline: background updates stay disabled for controller-launched workers (R286); future Claude Code upgrades are deliberate admission events - update intentionally, recapture fixtures, recertify, only then repin; never silently accept version drift (R287). PROHIBITED: DISABLE_UPDATES, downgrading Claude, unrelated global configuration changes (R280). Supervisor-source change: joins the Amendment-13 R247 recertification window (M0-T119). Supervisor-freeze qualifying evidence: D-024-R278 (also AD-093 provider CLI drift, reproduced live at seq 30: installed 2.1.251 vs certified 2.1.248).
business_reason: Owner Amendment 13 (2026-08-29, source-013-amendment.md): the CLI auto-updated mid-campaign and broke the certified identity; the certification window must be drift-proof before 2.1.251 is admitted.
outputs: Forced DISABLE_AUTOUPDATER=1 injection on EVERY controller-launched Claude child (both minimal_env call sites in claude_runner: worker launch ~1102 and probe launch ~1547), independent of parent environment and env allowlist (R278/R286)
Removal-sensitive tests: injection present on every claude launch path; NO other environment key added/changed; codex launches NOT modified (claude-scoped only)

Standing admission-event discipline documented in tools/agent_supervisor/README.md + docs/CONTROLLER_UPDATE_RUNBOOK.md: future Claude Code upgrades are deliberate admission events - update intentionally, recapture fixtures, recertify, only then repin; never silent drift (R287)
Owner-side workstation command pack recorded in the evidence report: exact administrator PowerShell command + verification command; owner executes it, never this side (R288)
